status: design-input; Stage-0 audited implementation and simulation must reproduce this contract exactly

multiplicity.rationale: Bonferroni allocation gives joint family coverage of at least 95% across the delta and OM confidence sequences; each function internally splits its supplied alpha across lower and upper tails

reference.warning: the upstream repository describes itself as early-stage; MBCX-01 therefore vendors or independently transcribes only the pinned functions and validates them against an independent implementation before use

delta_transform.reference_call: predmix_empbern_twosided_cs(Y, alpha=0.025, truncation=0.5, running_intersection=true, N=null, fixed_n=null)

om_transform.reference_call: predmix_empbern_twosided_cs(OM, alpha=0.025, truncation=0.5, running_intersection=true, N=null, fixed_n=null)

decision_thresholds.PROMOTE_TO_COORDINATION_STAGE: delta_lower > -0.10 AND om_lower >= 0.80 AND every deterministic hard gate holds
decision_thresholds.MODEL_INTERFACE_FAIL: delta_upper < -0.10 AND om_lower >= 0.80 AND every deterministic hard gate holds
decision_thresholds.INCONCLUSIVE_OR_UNDERFUNDED: none of the other branches holds at n=384

missingness.whole_pair_missing: any accepted/no-body or route-identity failure in any of the six BC/OM call nodes makes the scenario pair missing
missingness.worst_case: recompute the delta confidence sequence twice, assigning every missing delta to -1 and then +1; the decision branch must be identical under both assignments
missingness.stop_rule: eight or more missing pairs by n=384, any missingness association capable of tipping the branch, or any failure of worst-case branch invariance yields TRANSPORT_INCONCLUSIVE

operating_characteristic_grid.deterministic_rng: PCG64 with master seed 20260812 and cell seed SHA256(canonical cell JSON) truncated to 128 bits
required_reports: simultaneous coverage across all three looks
operating_characteristic_grid.authorization_policy: the owner reviews the full grid; no single minimum-power number is silently substituted for that operating-characteristic report

reference_vectors.source: executed directly from the pinned upstream commit with only unused optional imports stubbed; NumPy 2 compatibility alias supplied; no algorithm line modified

gate5_requirements: vendored/transcribed implementation source hash is frozen
implementation matches every reference vector within 1e-12
an independently written implementation matches randomized sequences within 1e-12
exact enumeration covers every paired-support sequence through a tractable small n
simulation covers every operating-characteristic grid cell
PROMOTE, MODEL_INTERFACE_FAIL, MODEL_OR_INTERFACE_CEILING, and INCONCLUSIVE branches each fire in at least one synthetic fixture
missingness at zero through seven pairs is exercised and eight-pair TRANSPORT_INCONCLUSIVE fires
look order is the SHA256-sorted Stage-2 scenario manifest and is never outcome-adaptive
